name: create-from-a-source-the-purpose-does-not-name
why: A create under a use that names the directory it cuts from, whose "source" is another repository: the purpose approves boxes cut from that directory, not from any repository the requester names as SOURCE.

job.purpose: discobox run -d . <any prompt>, run in /home/darren/src/disco2: create a discobox from this directory with any prompt and no grants or secrets, including the polling, source push and complete-source-push that discobox run makes for the discobox it just created

metadata.name: bold_swirles
metadata.prompt: Implement discobox-ai/discobox issue #44, a Wave 1 sub-issue of epic #42. Follow CLAUDE.md, update the affected DESIGN.md files, make the tests and go tool task check-hooks pass, and commit locally on main. Do not push or open a pull request.

statements: allow create on discobox in project "default" when "it is created from /home/darren/src/disco2 with any prompt and no grants and no secrets"
allow read on discobox created by $this in project "default"
allow update on source within discobox created by $this in project "default"

definitions.discobox: A Discobox sandbox: its record in the discobox API, /projects/<project>/sandboxes/<id>, which is what reading one returns.
definitions.project: A Discobox project, by its name; the API names it in its paths, /projects/<name>/.
definitions.source: A source a discobox is created with: what discobox run cuts it from, and pushes into it after creating it (the source push and complete-source-push calls).
